name: restro-pos
description: A multi-tenant Restaurant POS platform with three applications: 1. **Super Admin Portal** — platform owner manages all restaurant accounts, subscriptions, and platform-wide operations. 2. **Restaurant Admin Portal** — each restaurant manages its outlets, menu, tables, staff, inventory, settings, and reports. 3. **Restaurant POS Application** — staff operate the restaurant through role-based screens for counter, waiter, and kitchen workflows.
